messages.text: 好，那我先大概了解一下整体。现在想问纹理部分：Hunyuan3D-Paint 到底是怎么生成纹理的？它是直接在 3D 上生成颜色，还是从多视角图像推出来的？可以用中文简单解释一下，关键术语保留英文就行。

messages.short_answer: 根据论文，Hunyuan3D-Paint 不是直接在 3D 表面上逐点生成颜色，而是先以网格的 normal maps 和 position maps 为几何条件，生成多视角图像（multi-view images），再把这些图像 baking 成高分辨率的 texture map。论文摘要级别的段落没有详细说明 baking 的具体算法，所以这一部分只能确认整体流程。

sections.title: 论文描述的整体流程
sections.text: 论文说 Hunyuan3D-Paint 由一个以 mesh 为条件的多视角生成流程，加上用于预处理并把多视角图像 baking 成高分辨率纹理贴图的若干技术组成。图 2 的说明进一步指出，它以生成网格的 normal maps 和 position maps 作为输入，输出用于 texture baking 的多视角图像。

sections.title: 为什么要先做多视角图像
sections.text: 论文指出，training-free 的图像扩散模型存在 viewpoint bias 和多视角不一致的问题，因此发展了 multi-view image diffusion，并利用 objaverse 等大规模 3D 数据集来缓解这些问题。论文还举例说 Zero123++ 把六张多视角图像拼接成一张大图做 self-attention，MVDiffusion 则使用 correspondence-aware attention。

sections.title: 用简单的话理解这条流程
sections.text: 可以把它理解为：先从几何形状算出“每个像素在表面上的位置”和“朝向”这类信息，再让模型画出从多个角度看到的同一物体，最后把这些视角的图像按照几何关系“贴”回 3D 模型的 UV 贴图上。直接在 3D 上生成颜色很难保证各视角一致，所以用多视角图像作为中间步骤。这是我对论文流程的解释，论文原文没有逐句这样表述。

sections.title: 对你 AR 3D 资产研究的潜在用途
sections.text: 从你的研究方向看，这种“先多视角生成、再烘焙到纹理”的思路，可能适合把网络照片转成带纹理的 3D 资产，因为它能利用图像扩散模型的先验。不过，论文面向的是由 image 生成的 mesh，你需要判断公开照片中的遮挡、光照和相机信息是否能满足它的输入假设。这一点需要你结合自己的数据再评估。

Based on these advantages, Hunyuan3D-Paint is designed with a detailed preserving image injection module according to the philosophy of aligning the reference image not only semantically but also following the details as closely as possible. Multi-view Images Generation.Due to the viewpoint bias and multi-view inconsistency inherent in training-free image diffusion models, multi-view image diffusion was developed to alleviate these issues by utilizing large-scale 3D datasets, such as objaverse and objaverse-xl [20, 19]. Most works force the multi-view generated latents to communicate with each other by manipulating the self-attention layers with 3D-aware masks [ 36, 48, 88, 60, 95, 79, 78, 55]. For example, Zero123++ [78] first treats the multi-view attention as a self-attention on a large image, which is the spatial concatenation of six multi-view images. messages.text: 好，那我看一下 Figure 1。你能简单说一下 Figure 1 展示的是什么吗？是 texture 的结果，还是整个流程？

sections.title: 对手机实时 AR 的推测
sections.text: 基于常识，高分辨率的 dense mesh 加上高分辨率 texture map 通常会比低多边形模型更占用内存和渲染预算，所以直接放到手机 AR 中可能需要简化。这一判断是我的推理，论文中没有对此做验证。

sections.title: 对你 AR 研究的潜在用途
sections.text: 如果你的研究需要在手机上实时显示，可以把论文的低多边形化步骤看作生成后处理的一个候选环节，并在 face count 与纹理保真度之间做对比实验。论文强调 KD-tree 用于保留纹理，这对你评估简化后的纹理质量可能有参考价值。

sources.text: Low-polygon stylization can significantly reduce computational costs, making it an essential process in 3D asset management. To address this, we have established a low-polygon stylization module that efficiently converts the dense meshes generated by Hunyuan3D 2.0 into low-polygon meshes. This module operates in two steps: geometric editing and texture preserving. For geometric editing, we employ a faster and more robust traditional method [ 28, 35], despite the recent auto-regressive transformer-based polygon-generation approaches [97, 104, 86, 12]. By setting an optimization criterion, we merge the vertices of the mesh to transform the dense mesh into a low-polygon mesh. As shown at the top-right of Fig. 1, each 3D model can be represented by only dozens of triangles after geometric editing. The change in the face count of the mesh causes significant deviations in the vertices and faces of the low-polygon mesh compared to the dense mesh. Therefore, to preserve the texture patterns of the textured 3D assets, we construct a KD-tree for the input dense mesh.
quotes: As shown at the top-right of Fig. 1, each 3D model can be represented by only dozens of triangles after geometric editing.

Low-polygon stylization can significantly reduce computational costs, making it an essential process in 3D asset management. To address this, we have established a low-polygon stylization module that efficiently converts the dense meshes generated by Hunyuan3D 2.0 into low-polygon meshes. This module operates in two steps: geometric editing and texture preserving. For geometric editing, we employ a faster and more robust traditional method [ 28, 35], despite the recent auto-regressive transformer-based polygon-generation approaches [97, 104, 86, 12]. By setting an optimization criterion, we merge the vertices of the mesh to transform the dense mesh into a low-polygon mesh. As shown at the top-right of Fig. 1, each 3D model can be represented by only dozens of triangles after geometric editing. The change in the face count of the mesh causes significant deviations in the vertices and faces of the low-polygon mesh compared to the dense mesh. Therefore, to preserve the texture patterns of the textured 3D assets, we construct a KD-tree for the input dense mesh.

sections.title: 为什么要先做多视角图像
sections.text: 论文指出，training-free 的图像扩散模型存在 viewpoint bias 和多视角不一致的问题，因此发展了 multi-view image diffusion，并利用 objaverse 等大规模 3D 数据集来缓解这些问题。论文还举例说 Zero123++ 把六张多视角图像拼接成一张大图做 self-attention，MVDiffusion 则使用 correspondence-aware attention。

sections.title: 用简单的话理解这条流程
sections.text: 可以把它理解为：先从几何形状算出“每个像素在表面上的位置”和“朝向”这类信息，再让模型画出从多个角度看到的同一物体，最后把这些视角的图像按照几何关系“贴”回 3D 模型的 UV 贴图上。直接在 3D 上生成颜色很难保证各视角一致，所以用多视角图像作为中间步骤。这是我对论文流程的解释，论文原文没有逐句这样表述。

Low-polygon stylization can significantly reduce computational costs, making it an essential process in 3D asset management. To address this, we have established a low-polygon stylization module that efficiently converts the dense meshes generated by Hunyuan3D 2.0 into low-polygon meshes. This module operates in two steps: geometric editing and texture preserving. For geometric editing, we employ a faster and more robust traditional method [ 28, 35], despite the recent auto-regressive transformer-based polygon-generation approaches [97, 104, 86, 12]. By setting an optimization criterion, we merge the vertices of the mesh to transform the dense mesh into a low-polygon mesh. As shown at the top-right of Fig. 1, each 3D model can be represented by only dozens of triangles after geometric editing. The change in the face count of the mesh causes significant deviations in the vertices and faces of the low-polygon mesh compared to the dense mesh. Therefore, to preserve the texture patterns of the textured 3D assets, we construct a KD-tree for the input dense mesh.

Then, we build up a dual-single stream transformer [ 45] on the latent space of our V AE with the flow-matching [53, 24] objective. # Persona: Sam

"multi-view").

**What he wants.** To decide whether ideas or methods from a paper can inform his own research:
generating AR-ready 3D assets from photos that are publicly available on the web. Reading goal:
*Explore potential use in my research*.

**How he behaves.**
- Writes in Simplified Chinese mixed with English technical terms. Interface language: 中文（简体）.
- Sets a specific goal, begins with an overview, then asks focused questions about how the paper's key
  components connect, and about its logic, novelty, assumptions and limitations.
- Uses short references to earlier answers ("那第二个阶段呢", "this part", "你刚才说的那个").

- Relates the paper to his own setting: unconstrained web photos (varying lighting, occlusion, background,
  low resolution) and AR constraints (mesh size, PBR textures, real-time rendering).
- Expects a critical reading partner, not a summariser, examiner or unquestioning assistant.

**Paper.** Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation
(arXiv 2501.12202).
